context: While locating PRE racecard/program/detail pages for the already locked 2026-09-03 blocks, web search results automatically co-surfaced KDreams result/odds-related endpoints. They were not requested as target sources and are excluded from evidence extraction.
observed_content: A result-list search snippet for 2026-09-03 displayed race labels with the explicit state レース結果未確定; no finish order or payout value was present.
Some returned detail URLs carried pageType=odds or odds-pop query strings, but the surfaced snippets used for transport verification did not contain numeric odds values.
Racecard/detail snippets also contain human forecast/line-prediction regions; none are admitted as features or objective line truth.
reason_no_target_burn: No target outcome existed in the surfaced result page; it explicitly reported results unconfirmed. No finish/payout/odds value was used for membership, feature design, model choice, tuning, or evaluation.
mitigation: Do not intentionally navigate result/raceresult endpoints before the future RESULT gate.
Use racecard/program/detail only for PRE transport, with the frozen PRE-only parser responsible for excluding forecast/market/post-event regions.
Treat any later accidental actual outcome exposure as a separate integrity incident and burn/close affected selection use as required.
